Pass on the fake backend (gate exit 0 on two runs, same digest): evidence contract_checked, never an MHS-Device level. Model-authored and unreviewed. Not covered: the upstream package was never installed, imported or run (it needs pandas, numpy and gymnasium, pyproject.toml:22), so the fake backend (fake.py) replays a 120-row synthetic price series instead of a user DataFrame; its 3-value observations and its trajectories were not compared with a real run, and the real observation width is one per 'feature' column plus two dynamic features. The sim backend (gymnasium.make('TradingEnv', df=...)) is not offered or run because TradingEnv requires a caller-supplied DataFrame. The driver binds TradingEnv only; MultiDatasetTradingEnv is registered upstream (src/gym_trading_env/__init__.py:9-14) but is not bound by this package. fidelity.timestep_ms is 0 because the dataset, not the environment, fixes the interval between rows. No hardware, no operator-required limit; the device is simulated R0. Expected Gymnasium-family warnings are left as the exemplar leaves them: G6.NO_NATIVE_CALL for cap.world.seed.v1 (the seed only sets the seed of the next reset) and four G8.NO_UNIT for the integer inputs the bridge derives (ticks, action.index, seed twice). No extension ids were used, so there are no catalogue requests.
